notes.title: Shardbreaker
notes.notes:
[p][b]DOWNLOAD PAGE:[/b] [url="https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/154149-shardbreaker-part-1/"]https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/154149-shardbreaker-part-1/[/url][/p][p][b]How to play:[/b] Extract the .zip, and simply drag the .wad file over hedon.exe to run the map[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/33c5201dc3f7d736abe5a80fc6b5c4bc7e563f81.png"][/img]
After the release of [url="https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/154149-shardbreaker-part-1/"]Below the Gaudy Goblin[/url] by Doomax, Blake has stepped up to the Hedon Fan Map game and graced us with Shardbreaker - a full length Hedon map, with new graphics, new weapons and even new consumables and powerups![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/13d4f822485a678e1db1871d5c34ad5033fae3f1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/3e274adc4c063a96ed9dcaec0cef58fa545d39af.png"][/img]
The action takes place after Zan's victory over the Blue Baron. Still suffering from the lingering mind magics of the demon Icon, Zan is sent to recover in one of the Iron Division's remote infirmaries. 

The treatment? Walking around a detailed and meticulously crafted place, talking to the other patients, reading on lore, stocking up on ammo and venturing into an old dwarven fort. What lies beneath?

That's for you to discover...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/246c192657b5e0f552271ed687f3b66ca6a6df03.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/4032cbf9fce933538b2589b8e26b98cdb8085873.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/1344f77a727444e651450aa09b8326a6bac11f59.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/ac66167ce5a411fb028dd8d13b27a46bbd5afcd5.png"][/img]
Many thanks to Blake for showing the Hedon community some love, and if you want to see him work on the sequel of this, come [url="https://discord.gg/tUD9W4EbUd" style="button"]join us on Discord![/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/fd517f228c71cc55dbadb5f04362ff0a7fdb6c4f.png"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: Below the Gaudy Goblin
notes.notes:
After working for well over an year on it, Doomax has released the first Hedon fan map ever made - Below the Gaudy Goblin!

[i]On her journey to the dwarven fortress of Icepeak, Zan's patch is blocked by an avalanche. The only way around is through the mines near the Gaudy Goblin tavern... and whatever lies below.[/i]

notes.title: 2.4.2 Incremental Update
notes.notes:
[b]IMPORTANT: [/b]Updating Hedon requires a clean reinstall - this will cause your saves to become incompatible with the new version. You can revert to an older version of the game from Properties - Betas.

[h2]2024 is here. And so is 2.4.2[/h2]
It looks like yet another new year has caught me working on Hedon, although it's been quite some time since it shifted away from being my main project. Oh yes, I'm still working on a new game, but that doesn't mean I can no longer process player feedback and apply it in order to further improve Hedon :^)

[h2]Can you spot the differences?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/69eab6e1491655e27043b8cf7dfbdcdabf6e366b.png[/img]

As I have hinted on the [url=https://twitter.com/hedondev]platform formerly known as 'Twitter'[/url] a while ago, the more I keep working on Hedon, the smaller the adjustments become. The image above is a good example, showing how I switched a pair of windows to transparent bars which allow the player to see the 'treasure' inside the house, and thus have a better mental image of what they're in for as a reward to the exploration. A small gesture that may have a significant impact on the player's planning ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/5ed6cf305f3489884c5cb7075773ed21196702ab.gif[/img]
Another case is the elevator in the starting map. So far it has always been out of power from the get go, but as of 2.4.2, it will feature a small interaction which allows the player to see the Power Core explode and stop the moving platform. This small event will hopefully better 'cache' the elevator in the player's mind and allow them to make a better connection to it when finding the spare Power Core.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/6ca72804d9763fcdf27ba2ed82b6bdad5ef553ef.gif[/img]
The combat encounters are still receiving polish. Here's an example in which I have increased the number of Conscripts spawning in when first encountering the Crushbow, making for a far better demonstration of what the primary fire is capable of.


[h2]Incremental changes[/h2]
Last but not least, update 2.4.2 restores some of the dignity of certain monsters that have been habitually nerfed in previous updates. I've noticed that some of them feel a bit too tepid now, so I will be slowly increasing their aggression levels until I find the sweet spot. For a list of all changes, go ahead and check out the full [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1072150/discussions/0/1678064284163180341/]changelog.[/url]

So yeah, let me know how the changes work out! What are you waiting for, to battle!
- ZanDev

[h2]Realms Deep 2023[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/ad3d40b738c7e0de40ff7626066a5e79caa07dcd.png[/img]

Before anything, I'd like to remind you that Realms Deep 2023 is just around the corner! This time around, expect to find more than just boomer shooters, as the event has expanded to broader horizons of indie games. In celebration of the event I have released a new update for Hedon, and I will also be joining the massive [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RealmsDeep2023]RD2023 SALE[/url] which will be up from September 28th (7pm CEST) to October 3rd (7pm CEST)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/f4d38d57203122429acdbd4c049b6e06165169c3.png[/img]

I feel like Bloodrite has a few maps and areas that overstay their welcome. As you might know, I have a strong position against dumbing things down, so it was quite a challenge to figure out how I can streamline these areas by adding things rather than removing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/713704210f1369e37e028b01fe8192835c47b30a.png[/img]

Enter graphic clues, similar to the ones added in Crystal Heart, which are intended to provide the player with additional information about the map without directly spoon feeding it.

There are some other misc. changes, such as Warlocks no longer being immune to Time Freeze.
As usual, you can find the list of changes in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1072150/discussions/0/1678064284163180341/]Changelog[/url].

Let me know how you like the additions, and hey - why not drop a review here on Steam too? :^)
Anyway, enjoy Realms Deep and the new update, and good demon hunting!

notes.title: 2.4.0 Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[b]IMPORTANT: [/b]Updating Hedon requires a clean reinstall - this will cause your saves to become incompatible with the new version. If you are sure you want to perform the update, then remove your game folder from your Steam library and re-download it. Make sure to also delete any [i]hedon-username.ini[/i] type files from the game folder after you finish downloading, as they can get carried over by Steam cloud and mess with the update's default options and settings.

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/50b8540213dc62159c275dfbe9581a88994f9e1d.png[/img]
At long last, Hedon now has a custom movement code, stepping away from the classic Doom one which was too slippery to allow for precision platforming. It will be on by default, but can be reverted from [u]Options - Customize Controls[/u], and you can even bind a key to switch between movement styles instantly! 
On top of that, the new movement introduces terrain-based footstep sounds. Their volume can be adjusted from [i]Options - Sound Options[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/40ec548df71ec8c6c8106c1964f7815f1d4a3c7c.png[/img]
Another long awaited feature was to allow the player to reduce or entirely turn off camera shake resulted from using weapons. The weapon camera shake intensity can be found in [i]Options - Display Options[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/3b8ad7d94cd374a3b5fe5cb1e7cd367ae3e37028.png[/img]
One of the unfortunate realities of Hedon's development is that the graphics were drawn on a particular laptop screen which turned out to have its brightness and saturation turned up, thus making things look prettier than they were. Now that I have moved on to use a proper truecolor screen, I have noticed that Hedon looks a lot more drab and hard to read in reality. While this cannot be fully fixed, I made some changes and adjustments to address it.
On top of that, I there are new sprites, textures and decorations, predominantly used in Crystal Heart in order to improve the level of detail to better match that of Bloodrite.



There are a few other fixes and improvements. To view all the changes, access the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1072150/discussions/0/1678064284163180341/]Full Changelog here[/url]. Enjoy the update, and don't hesitate to send your feedback!
- ZanDev

notes.title: Hedon Bloodrite is Now Playable!
notes.notes:
[h2]A new journey awaits...[/h2]

[h3]Nithriel and her mangy cultists have given you a serious beating, but now that your home town has been saved, it's time to take the fight back at them! But can you stand against the imminent demonic invasion that is about to unleash upon the entire world?

[b]IMPORTANT: You need to [u]UNINSTALL AND REINSTALL HEDON[/u] for the update to work. Steam will then create a new folder 'Hedon Bloodrite' and thus allow you to keep your old Hedon version without messing any of the files and progress you had there.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/79d46f1f805e6bc3c19693b46cdde7f0bafae07e.png[/img]

It's been two crazy years of day-and-night development, and the final stretch was really grueling due to last moment PC issues but the day has finally arrived! Thanks a lot to everyone who supported and gave feedback and helped me improve the game during all this time!

We live in hard times so I figured it would be only fitting to reward you for playing Hedon by releasing this 12+ hour sequel as a FREE UPDATE, so if you enjoy it, don't forget to leave reviews and share the game with your friends and communities. It is your supreme duty to spread the word of the orc mommy ab enjoyers. 

Don't forget that we're building Hedon's community up on the Guilded.gg server, check it out below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/e5567ad08016b41a2b6fbe4ce1e3b13557076681.png[/img]


Anyway, have fun!

- Zan_HedonDev

notes.title: Hedon 2 Releasing This Summer!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release Date - Summer 2021[/h1]
For the past year I've been pretty much working non-stop on Hedon's sequel, so things moved faster than expected. Bloodrite is set to release in the [b]second half of summer 2021[/b], depending on how long I want to extend with beta testing. The game will be playable from the same .exe as Hedon, since file size more than allows it, but I'm not sure whether it will be added to the main game with a price increase or as a separate download. Wait until release :^)

[h1]16 Hours of Hand-Crafted Singleplayer Experience[/h1]
Hedon Bloodrite is pretty much Hedon on steroids, with larger levels, larger arsenal and bestiary, more world building and story and generally more... Hedon. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BiFGixdNmOebKAy5tQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]They messed up your home. It's your turn to mess theirs![/h1]
You'll be on the offensive now. Join the Iron Division remnants in a last ditch attempt to save the world from an imminent demonic invasion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/5bdf11547d9b6b1810e14abf7baacfe1b5223727.png[/img]

[h1]The world expands...[/h1]
Get ready to explore the universe of Hedon further and learn more about the places and people who inhabit the mysterious underground world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/131cfff3157b93231a1f5936eaacd6a9f2b284f0.png[/img]

[h1]A touch of RPG[/h1]
You will be able to talk to various characters and complete secondary objectives and hidden quests. Sometimes, your actions will affect the course of the game in subtle ways. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/04c005ca3441eb10c80c47c41ad54746903baa42.png[/img]

[h1]Lose yourself in the layers of the underworld[/h1]
As a true successor, Bloodrite will expand on Hedon's already large levels, keeping up the visual variety and strong atmosphere. Creativity, wits and exploration will never go unrewarded. In addition to that, you will be able to go back and worth between certain levels, having the freedom to approach them in multiple ways.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/a477VCEBeu9xn3j3xS/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Kick ass harder[/h1]
You get a weapon that shoots 2100 bullets a minute. Kicking ass is the only option.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/oCmlAOyjeoP1nXraNK/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/b5bPy7g9cbdAMdl5He/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h1]What is the fate of the underworld? Will Zan make the ultimate sacrifice to defeat the demons? Do male orcs exist?[/h1]
These and many other questions will find their answer in the sequel. The best part is that you won't have to wait more than three months from now to find out!

Until then, stay thirsty... for Bloodrite!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/8531dc3b669442612942c2e8f13f8db245b9dcc7.png[/img]


- Zan_HedonDev

notes.title: 1.6.0 Update - News From the Front
notes.notes:
[b]NOTE:[/b] Remember that updating has to be done manually through a clean reinstallation of Hedon, as the new content will break your save files. You should skip this update unless you want to start a new playthrough.

[h1]News From the Front[/h1]
It's been a rough year, but Hedon is still going strong! The sequel you're all waiting for is nearly half-way finished, and thanks to my wonderful Patreon supporters who have been with me during this terrible pandemic, I can dedicate my full time to developing it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/e7deaa620b09fd3a995546c66d8b2caaf3472509.png[/img]

And since waiting sucks, I have decided to release some of the content I'm working on so that you guys can have some fun! Just hit the in-game Testing Hub and check out the new weapons, items and allies inside, bearing in mind they are in a beta shape, and might change in the future. Your feedback is also welcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/d5b3c81e5f37ff7c5f2ac270cd72cacaaef643b0.png[/img]

On top of this I have also made many small improvements to the existing maps, and fixed a few bugs for certain weapons and enemies. Most importantly, however, I have updated Akhzul's soundtrack with a remastered and improved version. And after your requests, he has finally uploaded it on [url=https://akhzul.bandcamp.com/album/hedon-ost]his Bandcamp[/url] where you can now own it and support him!

[h2]1.6.0 Summary[/h2]

- Many map, monster and weapon fixes and improvements;
- Updated the old Akhzul soundtrack with a remastered version;
- Added beta versions of the Paingun, Stormstaff and Bracer of the Revenant (can be obtained only in Testing Hub or via the give all/give weapons/give ammo cheat commands);
- Added beta versions of the Iron Division Fixer and Earth Mother. They can only be recruited inside the Testing Hub.

[h1]Realms Deep 2020[/h1]
[previewyoutube=7S71Gib5Hdo;full][/previewyoutube]
I am also proud to announce that Hedon will be part of Realm's Deep 2020, the biggest boomer shooter online convention there is! Check it out below, and make sure to drop by during 5-6 September, 11:00 AM PT - 4:00 PM PT. You can find more info about it here - https://www.realmsdeep.game/

With this occasion, I will also be uploading a Demo for Hedon which will make it easier for people to get a feel of the game before they buy it. Tell your friends about it!


That's all for the time being, thanks to everyone for your attention and support, time for me to get back to work now!

notes.title: Quad Damage Bundle!
notes.notes:
QUAD DAMAGE BUNDLE - https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15144/Quad_Damage_Bundle/


A short while ago we reached out to a couple of dev-friends that launched well received, gore-filled, fps games. The reason? To discuss the possibility of launching a new bundle. One that would collect all of our games and offer it at the best possible price to all the fans of the genre.

Five large email threads, tens of discord messages and some really cool concept art and brainstorming later we arrived at what you see before your eyes: the Quad Damage Bundle featuring the barbaric [b]Elderborn[/b], the half-orcish [b]Hedon[/b], the mysterious [b]Nightmare Reaper[/b] and brooding [b]Project Warlock[/b].

Each game is a passion project by the creator, or a small handful of creators that managed to pour their heart and soul into lines of blood-sprayed and dismembered code. Do check them out.

This bundle is both about the chance to get all of these games at a reasonable price, and to discover titles you might not have been familiar with. So, without further ado: introducing four games to satiate your thirst for brutal, high-quality, no-nonsense fps.

Pry the secret of eternal youth from a cursed city as a powerful barbarian in [b]Elderborn[/b].

Take control of a pissed off Half-Orc in her quest to repel a cultist invasion in [b]Hedon[/b].

Solve the mystery of the nameless heroine in a mental asylum in [b]Nightmare Reaper[/b].

Face the minions of hell as a magic-wielding, gun-toting loner in [b]Project Warlock[/b].

[b]Elderborn[/b], [b]Hedon[/b], [b]Nightmare Reaper[/b] and [b]Project Warlock[/b] combine to bring you:

- 97 power-ups & skills !

- 101 weapons & spells !!

- 107 levels and stages !!!

- 120 enemies & bosses !!!!

Please remember: you only pay for the games you don’t yet own here. Also: for the best deal you might want to buy Quad Damage Bundle between 01.06-08.06!

notes.title: 1.5.0 Is Out! And a New Episode is in Development
notes.notes:
[b]ATTENTION![/b] You must manually perform the update. As usual, it comes with a newer version of the GZDoom Engine, as well as tweaks for each and every map, which [b]causes old saves to become incompatible[/b]. For this reason, auto-updating is off and must be performed manually, preferably via a clean reinstall.

Also in line with Hedon's other patches, this is aimed at new players and players who want to start fresh runs. If you're in the middle of some progress, you have little reason to perform this update until you're done with your current playthrough.

Alternatively, you can manually select levels and restore your gear. See how [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1072150/discussions/0/2530372519561985643/]HERE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/b53a7d4b40e17208b5588ddab72fa14ff002e00e.png[/img]

1.5.0 IS HERE

The update that changes Hedon's starting experience is finally out! Enjoy a whole new short starting area coming with a much more organic introduction to the mechanics and lore of the game, as well as some proper head-on action!

You can find the changelog [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1072150/discussions/0/1678064284163180341/]HERE[/url].

This took a while to make, primarily because it required me to first work on assets that were destined for the second chapter of the game. Second chapter? Yep, it's officially in development, thanks to my [b]amazing Patreon supporters![/b] 

That's where I will be posting sneak peeks, closed beta builds and updates from now on, so keep an eye out for it. Also don't forget that I now have a [url=https://twitter.com/hedondev]Twitter account[/url], where I will also post news from time to time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948122/f7e4045b932607762ced84f1590c90a65901476d.png[/img]

Thanks a lot for playing and for showing interest in Hedon this far! Stay tuned!

- Hedon now runs on a GZDoom 4.1.3 engine fork "hGZDoom" with few quality of life improvements and Hedon-specific setting menus (otherwise it's 99.999% GZDoom);
- New Bearzerk difficulty that removes access to guns and instead gives the player new melee weapons for the ultimate close combat challenge!
- Various map improvements and adjustments, including further optimization for Map10;
- Improved graphics, animations and sounds for all the weapons;
- New Quick Kick attack;
- New blood cloud gore effects and various other enemy improvements and changes.
